Our story · Seoul to Bengaluru

Authentic Korean cuisine,
served with passion.

At Koreyaki, we bring the rich flavours and traditions of Korea to the heart of Indiranagar. From comforting street-food favourites to classic Korean specialties, every dish is crafted to make your meal memorable.

Whether you’re discovering Korean cuisine for the first time or you’re a longtime fan, come together over Korean fried chicken, ramen, bibimbap, tteokbokki, dumplings and refreshing bubble tea.

The Koreyaki promise

Good food.
Warm hearts.

Traditional recipes, quality ingredients and warm hospitality — served fresh every day.

Authentic recipesClassic Korean cooking techniques and bold, familiar flavours.

Warm hospitalityA welcoming place to share great food and good moments.

FAQ

Questions? We’ve
got answers.

What type of cuisine do you serve?

Koreyaki specialises in Korean fried chicken, ramen, bibimbap, tteokbokki, dumplings, rice bowls and bubble tea.

Where are you located?

11th Main Road, HAL 2nd Stage, Appareddipalya, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008.

What are your opening hours?

Every day, 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM. No weekly holiday.

Do you offer vegetarian options?

Please contact our team to check current vegetarian dishes and ingredients.

Can I reserve a table?

Yes. Complete the reservation form and send your request through WhatsApp.

When will my reservation be confirmed?

We aim to confirm requests within 30 minutes during operating hours.
